scope: Static recovered-source inspection for next implementation units; not native execution evidence.

entries.correction: The original weightBelts value sums main + ends + upper only. Despite the group title, bulkhead and bulge are excluded.
entries.current_product_boundary: Selected role totals already exist for physical/empirical inputs; no new aggregate ledger item should be created.

entries.correction: The source total adds three belts, bulkhead, bulge, deck, conning and gun armour.
entries.current_product_boundary: A selected ledger total and a sum of current component estimates are distinct readings; never add them together or adopt the aggregate again.

entries.correction: The original applies a mount-count-weighted layout factor to a whole-battery mount estimate using all barrels.
entries.current_product_boundary: Two-row adapted proposals remain authoritative for adoption until an explicit whole-battery allocation policy is designed and checked.

entries.correction: The source total is gun + mount + armour and excludes magazine. Magazine and broadside are separate.
entries.current_product_boundary: A linked system ledger may contain ammunition; it cannot silently substitute for this source-labelled total.

entries.correction: Only the two torpedo rows with location 0..3 contribute; footprint sum is divided by waterplane area.
entries.current_product_boundary: Sets are a divisor with integer division in two source branches; do not infer a free physical deck area or weapon firing arcs.

entries.correction: Only torpedo locations 4..8 contribute a volume-like term divided by length * bulged beam * draught * block coefficient.
entries.current_product_boundary: The source variable is called area in both branches but has different dimensions. Missing bulged beam cannot silently become unbulged beam.

entries.correction: Default is a button that proposes eight dimension fields. It is not an opaque armour-type preset and does not set plate thicknesses.
entries.current_product_boundary: Main height uses source side draught derived from block coefficient. Text is rounded to two decimals in the active source scale before parse-back; this is distinct from the exact raw formula.

source_behaviour_requiring_policy: Torpedo zero sets are mutated to one in the original UI; current canonical input must not be mutated.
Integer number/sets truncation and sets greater than number can produce odd footprint results.
Zero torpedo count may still leave a positive footprint in source trainable branches; decide and document supported product domain before parity claims.
Default text rounding may produce different canonical dimensions in metric and imperial source scales.
